title: fss.reconstruction_atlas_adopted.v2
description: Complete private create-only localization-atlas export from static features using the explicit adopted-radial image profile. The versioned manifest retains both raw and corrected lineage, exact current calibration/adoption and every source/model/map/mask/geometry receipt. FSATLAS1 bytes and bounds remain unchanged. SHA-256 hashes the exact compact report body; the embedded manifest is validated separately after decoding its string and its exact UTF-8 digest is the archive provenance pin. Full source/current-privacy and current-adoption/withdrawal revalidation precedes publication under a held deployment owner. Unknown absolute error is preserved, no future source-access authority is granted and existing output files are never overwritten. Complete JSON including newline is bounded to 32 MiB.

provenance_manifest_utf8.description: Exact original UTF-8 v2 provenance manifest. Its SHA-256 equals archive.provenance_digest and the FSATLAS1 provenance pin; validate its decoded JSON against reconstruction_atlas_adopted_provenance.v2.json. contentSchema is annotation-only in some validators. Whitespace/key-order changes change identity.
